text: (b) (i) With respect to each Album of the Minimum Recording Obligation, PRI shall pay to Grantor an Advance equal to the applicable amount set forth below.

text: The Advance payable with respect to the first Album of the Minimum RecoIding Obligation in the Initial Period ,...... shall be payable one-quarter (1/4) wi thin sixty (60) days (the "First Sixty Days") following the day of PRI' s receipt of this agreement I fully executed by Grantor and Artist, one-quarter (1/4) promptly following PRI's receipt of notice of commencement of recording, one-quarter (l/4) promptly following PRI S receipt of I notice of commencement of mixing such Album and the balance promptly following delivery of all Master Recordings and other materials required to be delivered pursuant to Articles 3 and 4 and paragraph 10.03 with respect to such Album, provided, however, that if Grantor commences to .- record such Album within the First Sixty Days, then the aggregate of the one-quarter (1/4) of the Advance payable within the First Sixty Days and the one-quarter (l/4) of the Advance payable on commencement of recording shall be payable promptly following PRI's receipt of Grantor's notice of commencement of recording such Album.

text: The Advance payable with respect to the second Album of the Minimum Recording Obligation in the Initial Period and each of the first through third Option Periods, if any, shall be paid one-half (1/2) promptly following PRI S receipt of notice I of commencement of recording, one-quarter (1/4) promptly following PRI's receipt of notice of commencement of mixing the applicable Album, and the balance prompt ly following delivery of all Master Recordings and other materials required to be delivered pursuant to Articles 3 and 4 and paragraph 10.03 with respect to such Album.

name: 6. Paragraph 6.01(b)(ii) – Recording Costs
text: (ii) Grantor shall be responsible for the payment of all Recording Costs or other costs in connection with making Master Recordings.

text: If PRl elects to pay any such costs for which Grantor is responsible, then PRI sha 11 have the right to demand reimbursement therefor from Grantor (and Grantor shall immediately make such reimbursement) and/or the right to deduct such costs from any and all monies payable hereunder, except mechanical royalty payments.

name: 8. Concert Video Purchase
text: 8. The parties acknowledge and agree that pursuant to a separate agreement dated as of April 3, 1989, PRI shall purchase from Red Star Entertainment Co., Ltd. a "long-form· Audio-Visual Recording embodying your concert performances in the Soviet Union during February 1989 (the "Concert Video·).

name: 8(a). Satisfaction of Production Obligation
text: (a) PRI' s purchase of the Concert video shall be deemed to satisfy any obligation PRI may have pursuant to paragraph 5.02(a)(ii) of the Agreement to produce an AudiO-Visual Recording in connection 'With the first Album of the Minimum Recording Obligation for the first Option PeriOd.

name: 8(b). Concert Video Exploitation Rights
text: (b) Notwithstanding anything to the contrary expressed or implied in paragraph 5.02(b) of the Agreement, PRI may exploit, or refrain from exploiting, the Concert Video as it deems appropriate in its sole discretion including, without limi tat ion , editing the Concert Video for promotional and/or commercial purposes and manufacturing and exploiting AudiO-Visual Devices and/or CD/Videos embodying the Concert Video or any portion thereof.

name: 8(c). Concert Video Costs and Recoupment
text: (c) All amounts paid by PRI in connection with the Concert Video, including, without limitation, the cost of purchasing the Concert Video from Red Star Entertainment Co., Ltd., and any editing costs and/or post-production costs incurred in connection with the Concert Video, shall be deemed to be Advances under the Agreement, provided that only fifty percent (50%) of such costs shall be recoupable from audio-only Record royalties accrued to your royalty account under the Agreement.

name: 9. Audio-Visual Devices Definition
text: (a) "AUdio-Visual Devices": All forms of reproductions of Audio-Visual Recordings, excluding CD/video, now or hereafter known, manufactured or distributed primarily for home and/or juke box use and/or use on or in means of transportation.

text: (g) ReDIVideo-: A Phonograph Record in laser-read compact disc form embodying Audio-Visual Recordings, which may, without limitation, include additional audio-only Sides.

text: (h) As used herein, the phrase ·or equivalent- shall mean every form of pre-recorded tape, compact disc or any other Record equivalent.

text: 11. All terms not defined herein shall have the same meaning given them in the Agreement.
